scoring_justification: All headline quantities can be recomputed from submitted raw artifacts: structural properties table is checked for correct trend and specific values; transition pressure is compared to paper; piezoelectric coefficient matched; phonon frequencies checked for softening behavior.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference values for structural properties at key pressures, expected transition pressure, piezoelectric coefficient, and phonon frequencies
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from Fig.2 and Fig.3 of the paper, supplemented by text descriptions.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's reported ranges: c/a ~1.55-1.60 at low P, ~1.25 at high P; u ~0.375 low, ~0.50 high; transition pressure ~12 GPa; e33 ~2 C/m²; phonon softening near 12 GPa with A1(TO) frequency approaching zero.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the paper's published quantitative findings and serve as the reproduction gold standard.

outputs.description: Structural parameters (axial ratio, internal u parameters, volume per 4 atoms) of the 1×1 GaN/ScN superlattice as a function of hydrostatic pressure.

schema.description: A single float value representing the transition pressure in GPa.

outputs.description: The pressure at which the isostructural phase transition occurs in 1×1 GaN/ScN, determined from enthalpy crossing or inflection point analysis.

schema.description: A single float value representing the e33 piezoelectric coefficient in C/m².

outputs.description: Piezoelectric coefficient e33 of the 1×1 GaN/ScN superlattice at ambient pressure (~0 GPa).
Zone-center A1(TO) phonon frequency of the 1×1 GaN/ScN superlattice at several pressures near the transition, showing soft-mode behavior.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs must be derived from the DFT/DFPT calculations. The structural properties table must show a continuous structural transition with axial ratio and internal parameters changing as pressure increases. The transition pressure should be determined from the structural data (e.g., inflection point or equation-of-state analysis). The phonon frequency should soften to a minimum near the transition. The piezoelectric coefficient should be reported at ambient pressure.
